basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old living in Toronto, Canada, who stumbled into the world of cryptocurrency way back in 2012. Since then, I've been leveraging my early investments to navigate life without a traditional job, especially after some health issues in late 2018. My days are spent tending to my indoor garden, playing the latest games on PS5, and trying to live a more sustainable, zero-waste lifestyle. I'm single and usually online late at night, catching up on Reddit threads or managing my investments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which initially sparked my interest in tech and cryptocurrencies. Most of my expertise comes from self-study and actively participating in online communities. I've also developed a keen interest in personal finance, particularly with a Canadian context, due to my own financial management experiences.
